title: A coherent sheaf with zero-dimensional support is supported on a finite subscheme
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$ [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-morphism-conventions], let $\mathcal F$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and suppose that $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ has dimension at most zero [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let $\mathcal N$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Then there exist a finite-dimensional $k$-algebra $A$ [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace] [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], a closed immersion $i:\operatorname{Spec}(A)\hookrightarrow X$ [def-weil-closed-immersion], and a coherent module $\mathcal G$ on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [pqf-def-coherent] such that the underlying set of $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ is $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$, $\mathcal F\cong i_*\mathcal G$, and $\mathcal F\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal N\cong i_*(\mathcal G\otimes i^*\mathcal N)$. In particular, $\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal N$ is coherent and has the same support as $\mathcal F$. For every $q\ge0$, the closed immersion gives canonical isomorphisms $H^q(X,\mathcal F)\cong H^q(\operatorname{Spec}(A),\mathcal G)$ and $H^q(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal N)\cong H^q(\operatorname{Spec}(A),\mathcal G\otimes i^*\mathcal N)$, where cohomology and global sections are those of [def-pc-euler-characteristic].

source.place: Tag 0AYT (varieties-lemma-chi-tensor-finite), proof of parts (3)--(5): the annihilator closed subscheme of a coherent module with zero-dimensional support is finite over the field, and cohomology is unchanged under its closed pushforward

proof.text: The support of the coherent module is closed [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-module-support-closed]. Since $X$ is finite type over $k$ and the support has dimension at most zero, [lem-sc-dim0-finite] makes it a finite set of closed points. The scheme-theoretic support construction [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-theoretic-support] gives a closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ with underlying set this support and with annihilator ideal killing $\mathcal F$.

source.place: Tag 0AYT, proof of parts (3)--(5), and Tag 05JU

proof.text: The closed subscheme $Z$ has zero-dimensional underlying space and is algebraic over $k$, so [lem-pc-zero-dimensional-closed-subscheme-finite] gives that $Z\to\operatorname{Spec}(k)$ is finite and affine, with $A:=\Gamma(Z,\mathcal O_Z)$ finite-dimensional over $k$ and $Z\cong\operatorname{Spec}(A)$.

source.place: Tag 0AYT, proof: the annihilator closed subscheme with zero-dimensional support is finite over the field

proof.text: Since $X$ is of finite type over $k$, $X$ and its closed subscheme $Z$ are Noetherian. Because the annihilator ideal kills $\mathcal F$, the closed-immersion coherent equivalence gives a coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal G$ with $\mathcal F\cong i_*\mathcal G$ [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-coherent-equivalence]. The closed-immersion cohomology lemma [lem-pc-closed-immersion-coherent-cohomology] gives $H^q(X,\mathcal F)\cong H^q(Z,\mathcal G)$ for every $q$ and, for the invertible module $\mathcal N$ on $X$, the projection isomorphism $\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal N\cong i_*\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal N\cong i_*(\mathcal G\otimes i^*\mathcal N)$; pullback preserves invertibility by the local definition [def-sc-invertible-module], so $\mathcal G\otimes i^*\mathcal N$ is coherent and, by the same lemma, so is $\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal N$, whose cohomology is $H^q(Z,\mathcal G\otimes i^*\mathcal N)$. Tensoring by an invertible module preserves nonzero stalks, so the supports agree.

Apply [lem-pc-finite-scheme-cohomology-tensor] to $Z=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, $\mathcal G$, and $i^*\mathcal N$. This supplies the stated cohomology identifications, coherence and finite-dimensionality assertions, vanishing for $q>0$, and equality of the global-section dimensions after tensoring.
